summary: ArriVent BioPharma filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market (ATM) equity offering of up to $250 million in common stock through Jefferies as sales agent. The filing is a routine shelf takedown under an existing S-3 registration statement, with no acquisition, divestiture, or other special situation involved. Shares will be sold at prevailing market prices (last reported $29.50 on May 8, 2026), with Jefferies receiving a 3% commission. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes. There is no premium, fixed price, or structural complexity; this is a standard capital markets transaction.
